import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;

    static class ModInt {
        int val;

        ModInt(long v) {
            if (v < 0) v = v % MOD + MOD;
            if (v >= MOD) v %= MOD;
            val = (int) v;
        }

        ModInt(int v) {
            this((long) v);
        }

        static int modInv(int a) {
            int g = MOD, r = a, x = 0, y = 1;
            while (r != 0) {
                int q = g / r;
                g %= r;
                int tmp = g; g = r; r = tmp;
                x -= q * y;
                tmp = x; x = y; y = tmp;
            }
            return x < 0 ? x + MOD : x;
        }

        ModInt add(ModInt other) {
            int res = val + other.val;
            if (res >= MOD) res -= MOD;
            return new ModInt(res);
        }

        ModInt subtract(ModInt other) {
            int res = val - other.val;
            if (res < 0) res += MOD;
            return new ModInt(res);
        }

        ModInt multiply(ModInt other) {
            long prod = (long) val * other.val;
            return new ModInt(prod % MOD);
        }

        ModInt divide(ModInt other) {
            return multiply(other.inv());
        }

        ModInt inv() {
            return new ModInt(modInv(val));
        }

        ModInt pow(long p) {
            ModInt a = this, result = new ModInt(1);
            while (p > 0) {
                if ((p & 1) == 1) result = result.multiply(a);
                a = a.multiply(a);
                p >>= 1;
            }
            return result;
        }

        ModInt negate() {
            return val == 0 ? new ModInt(0) : new ModInt(MOD - val);
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object o) {
            if (this == o) return true;
            if (o == null || getClass() != o.getClass()) return false;
            ModInt modInt = (ModInt) o;
            return val == modInt.val;
        }

        @Override
        public int hashCode() {
            return val;
        }
    }

    static class LongKey {
        long value;

        LongKey(long value) {
            this.value = value;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object o) {
            if (this == o) return true;
            if (o == null || getClass() != o.getClass()) return false;
            LongKey longKey = (LongKey) o;
            return value == longKey.value;
        }

        @Override
        public int hashCode() {
            return (int) splitmix64(value ^ FIXED_RANDOM);
        }

        static long splitmix64(long x) {
            x += 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15L;
            x = (x ^ (x >>> 30)) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9L;
            x = (x ^ (x >>> 27)) * 0x94d049bb133111ebL;
            return x ^ (x >>> 31);
        }

        static final long FIXED_RANDOM;

        static {
            long seed = System.nanoTime() * (System.identityHashCode(new Object()) | 1);
            FIXED_RANDOM = splitmix64(seed);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int N = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        ModInt[][] probability = new ModInt[N][N];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                int p = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
                probability[i][j] = new ModInt(p).divide(new ModInt(100));
            }
        }

        List<List<Integer>> masksWithCount = new ArrayList<>(N + 1);
        for (int i = 0; i <= N; i++) masksWithCount.add(new ArrayList<>());
        int[] lookup = new int[1 << N];
        Arrays.fill(lookup, -1);

        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << N); mask++) {
            int count = Integer.bitCount(mask);
            lookup[mask] = masksWithCount.get(count).size();
            masksWithCount.get(count).add(mask);
        }

        Map<LongKey, ModInt> possibleMasks = new HashMap<>();
        possibleMasks.put(new LongKey(1L << lookup[0]), new ModInt(1));

        for (int left = 0; left < N; left++) {
            Map<LongKey, ModInt> newPossibleMasks = new HashMap<>();
            ModInt[] products = new ModInt[1 << N];
            for (int current = 0; current < (1 << N); current++) {
                ModInt prod = new ModInt(1);
                for (int right = 0; right < N; right++) {
                    if ((current >> right & 1) == 1) {
                        prod = prod.multiply(probability[left][right]);
                    } else {
                        prod = prod.multiply(new ModInt(1).subtract(probability[left][right]));
                    }
                }
                products[current] = prod;
            }

            long[] newBits = new long[N];
            long[] newPossible = new long[1 << N];

            for (Map.Entry<LongKey, ModInt> entry : possibleMasks.entrySet()) {
                long possible = entry.getKey().value;
                ModInt prob = entry.getValue();

                Arrays.fill(newBits, 0L);

                for (int mask : masksWithCount.get(left)) {
                    if ((possible >> lookup[mask] & 1) == 1) {
                        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                            if ((mask >> i & 1) == 0) {
                                newBits[i] |= 1L << lookup[mask | (1 << i)];
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                newPossible[0] = 0L;
                for (int current = 1; current < (1 << N); current++) {
                    int lsb = current & -current;
                    int idx = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(current);
                    newPossible[current] = newPossible[current ^ lsb] | newBits[idx];
                    LongKey key = new LongKey(newPossible[current]);
                    ModInt add = prob.multiply(products[current]);
                    newPossibleMasks.merge(key, add, ModInt::add);
                }
            }

            possibleMasks = newPossibleMasks;
            System.err.println(possibleMasks.size());
        }

        ModInt answer = new ModInt(0);
        long fullMaskKey = 1L << lookup[(1 << N) - 1];
        for (Map.Entry<LongKey, ModInt> entry : possibleMasks.entrySet()) {
            if ((entry.getKey().value & fullMaskKey) != 0) {
                answer = answer.add(entry.getValue());
            }
        }

        System.out.println(answer.val);
    }
}
